summary: Frontend testing of purchase flow UX improvements in SorteoLanding.js. All 9 features passed testing successfully. The loading indicators, button disabled states, dialog close prevention, error handling, and success redirect are all working correctly.

issues: Console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for {DialogContent} - accessibility improvement recommended

critical_code_review_comments: The validandoBoletos and comprando states are correctly implemented to prevent double-clicks
The onOpenChange handler correctly prevents dialog closure during purchase with the comprando guard
Error handling shows toast messages for validation failures
Success flow correctly shows success toast and redirects to /usuario?tab=boletos
seed_data_creation: Purchased 100 additional test tickets during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All purchase flow UX improvements are working correctly. Test user now has 620 pending boletos on sorteo 'mas de mil boletos' (79b390f8). The sorteo 08638947 (gfjhg) has a mismatch issue where it shows minimum 2 boletos but only renders 1 input field - this appears to be a pre-existing data/state issue not related to this UX update.
